name: refactor_ruby_case_when_to_hash_dispatch
description: Refactors a case/when currency-symbol lookup into a Hash dispatch table without changing behavior
prompts: Currency.symbol_for(code) in lib/currency.rb maps a currency code to its display symbol using a case/when chain: "USD" -> "$", "EUR" -> "\u20ac", "GBP" -> "\u00a3", "JPY" -> "\u00a5", and any other code returns the code itself unchanged. Refactor it to use a Hash dispatch table (map each known code to its symbol) instead of the case/when chain, looked up with a sensible default for unknown codes. Do not change observable behavior: the four known codes must still map to the same symbols, and an unknown code (e.g. "XYZ") must still return itself unchanged. Keep the symbol_for(code) signature.

setup_files.lib/currency.rb:
module App
  class Currency
    def self.symbol_for(code)
      case code
      when "USD"
        "$"
      when "EUR"
        "\u20ac"
      when "GBP"
        "\u00a3"
      when "JPY"
        "\u00a5"
      else
        code
      end
    end
  end
end

test_setup_files.test/refactor_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/currency"

class CurrencyRefactorTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_known_codes
    assert_equal "$", App::Currency.symbol_for("USD")
    assert_equal "\u20ac", App::Currency.symbol_for("EUR")
    assert_equal "\u00a3", App::Currency.symbol_for("GBP")
    assert_equal "\u00a5", App::Currency.symbol_for("JPY")
  end

  def test_unknown_code_passthrough
    assert_equal "XYZ", App::Currency.symbol_for("XYZ")
  end
end

reference_solution.lib/currency.rb:
module App
  class Currency
    SYMBOLS = {
      "USD" => "$",
      "EUR" => "\u20ac",
      "GBP" => "\u00a3",
      "JPY" => "\u00a5",
    }.freeze

    def self.symbol_for(code)
      SYMBOLS.fetch(code, code)
    end
  end
end

module App
  class Currency
    SYMBOLS = {
      "USD" => "$",
      "EUR" => "\u20ac",
      "GBP" => "\u00a3",
      "JPY" => "\u00a5",
    }.freeze

    # DRIFT: unknown codes now return nil instead of the code itself.
    def self.symbol_for(code)
      SYMBOLS[code]
    end
  end
end
